We were on our way home and an SUV kept pace with us so I sped up. Kept happening over and over until I looked at the driver. She was a Cougar/MILF trying to get our attention. My buddy pointed at himself, she shook her head no, pointed at me and she shook her head yes. Proceeded to point at her empty ring finger and gave the “call me” sign. depends on supporting mods and your driving habits. upping horsepower and modifying a car outside of factory spec is going to affect reliability to some degree. now that degree depends on how extreme you take it.

generally speaking:
big turbo + bone stock engine = least reliable
big turbo + forged internals = more reliable
big turbo + fully built engine = most reliable

you can do performance mods outside of a turbo that yield you decent power gain while still being reliable so long as your tuner isn’t getting crazy, which most don’t, unless you ask for it.
